source: Qudūrī — Intro to Qudūrī, class notes 2026-09-09

cards.front: What role does مُخْتَصَر القُدُورِي play for a student?
cards.back: The entry point into the Ḥanafī school of thought

cards.front: What is the stated purpose of مُخْتَصَر القُدُورِي?
cards.back: To present the relied-upon positions of the madhhab

cards.front: What does مُخْتَصَر القُدُورِي deliberately leave out, and what does that make it?
cards.back: It mentions no evidences — it is simply a manual of law

cards.meaning: linguistically — a definition by the word's ordinary language sense
technically — a definition by the term's specialist usage

cards.text: Scholars define a term two ways: {{c1::لُغَةً::linguistically}} and {{c2::اِصْطِلَاحًا::technically}}
For a definition to be sound it must be {{c1::مَانِع::excluding}} — excluding what does not belong — and {{c2::جَامِع::including}} — including everything that does

cards.meaning: preventive — a definition excludes whatever is not necessary to it
comprehensive — a definition includes everything necessary to it

cards.front: What does فِقْه mean لُغَةً?
cards.back: To understand and comprehend

cards.front: Who gave one of the first technical definitions of فِقْه, and what was it?
cards.back: Imām Abū Ḥanīfah — an individual knowing their rights and responsibilities

cards.text: Abū Ḥanīfah's definition of فِقْه: {{c1::مَعْرِفَةُ النَّفْسِ مَا لَهَا وَمَا عَلَيْهَا}}
cards.extra: an individual knowing their rights and responsibilities

cards.front: What is the problem with Abū Ḥanīfah's definition of فِقْه?
cards.back: It is very broad — it takes in ʿaqīdah and ādāb as well

cards.text: The refined definition of فِقْه: {{c1::الْعِلْمُ بِالْأَحْكَامِ الشَّرْعِيَّةِ}} {{c2::الْعَمَلِيَّةِ}} {{c3::الْمُكْتَسَبَةِ مِنْ أَدِلَّتِهَا التَّفْصِيلِيَّةِ}}
cards.extra: the knowledge of practical legal rulings derived from their detailed evidences

cards.front: Translate the refined definition of فِقْه.
cards.back: The knowledge of practical legal rulings derived from their detailed evidences

cards.front: In the definition of فِقْه, what do “the detailed evidences” refer to?
cards.back: The four sources of fiqh

cards.front: Name the four sources of فِقْه. (Q, S, I, Q)
cards.back: القُرْآن، السُّنَّة، الإِجْمَاع، القِيَاس

cards.front: What does “practical legal rulings” mean in the definition of فِقْه?
cards.back: The laws related to a person's actions or conduct

cards.front: What does the refined definition of فِقْه exclude, and to which science does that belong?
cards.back: Knowledge related to the articles of faith — that is the subject of ʿaqīdah

cards.text: The three categories of فِقْه: {{c1::عِبَادَات}}, {{c2::مُعَامَلَات}}, and {{c3::جِنَايَات}}

cards.meaning: rules and regulations of worship and its related actions, such as purification
commercial and interpersonal law, and judicial matters — adjudication, court procedure, evidence
crimes, offences, and their penalties — criminal law

cards.front: Which categories of فِقْه does القُدُورِي cover?
cards.back: All three — عِبَادَات، مُعَامَلَات، جِنَايَات

cards.front: What does شَرِيعَة mean لُغَةً?
cards.back: A watering hole or drinking place — where a person or animal comes to drink

cards.front: What does شَرِيعَة mean اِصْطِلَاحًا?
cards.back: What Allah has legislated for His servants from the religion — Allah's revealed code

cards.front: What is the شَرِيعَة for?
cards.back: It is what we follow to be guided in this world and to attain salvation

cards.front: What does the شَرِيعَة include?
cards.back: Creed, ritual acts of worship, morals, ethics, and law

cards.text: {{c1::فِقْه}} and {{c2::شَرِيعَة}} are often used interchangeably, but {{c3::شَرِيعَة}} is far the broader of the two

cards.front: What does شَرِيعَة take in that فِقْه does not?
cards.back: Creed, morals, and ethics — فِقْه is confined to practical legal rulings

cards.front: From which verb does مَذْهَب derive, and what does it mean?
cards.back: ذَهَبَ / يَذْهَبُ — to go, or to take as a way

cards.front: Grammatically, what two things can مَذْهَب be?
cards.back: Either a ظَرْف مَكَانِي or a مَصْدَر

cards.front: What does مَذْهَب mean لُغَةً?
cards.back: A way, course, or manner of acting; an opinion on a particular case; a doctrine; the opinion one chooses to adopt

cards.front: What does مَذْهَب mean اِصْطِلَاحًا?
cards.back: A legal school, or legal school of thought

cards.text: A مَذْهَب is a non-formal association of jurists sharing loyalty to {{c1::a particular set of legal precepts}} and {{c2::a particular methodology of interpretation and of deriving law}}

cards.front: Name the four extant مَذَاهِب. (Ḥ, M, Sh, Ḥ)
cards.back: حَنَفِي، مَالِكِي، شَافِعِي، حَنْبَلِي

cards.front: After whom is each مَذْهَب named?
cards.back: A master-jurist — a مُجْتَهِد قَطْعِي — to whom a particular methodology of deriving law is attributed

cards.front: Were there ever more than four مَذَاهِب?
cards.back: Yes — there used to be many more; these four were codified, preserved, and survived

cards.meaning: one who performs ijtihād — the master-jurist a madhhab is named for

cards.front: What is اِجْتِهَاد?
cards.back: The effort made to derive law, which is not self-evident, from the primary sources

cards.front: What does اِجْتِهَاد require of the one performing it?
cards.back: A great deal of skill and expertise across many subject areas

cards.text: A مَذْهَب is both {{c1::a framework for interpreting and deriving law from the Qurʾān and Sunnah}} and {{c2::the body of law that comes out of that framework}}

cards.front: Does following the Ḥanafī madhhab mean holding every opinion of Imām Abū Ḥanīfah?
cards.back: No — it is following the scholarly tradition that developed over time by adhering to the methodology of the founders

cards.front: Is following a مَذْهَب an objective in itself?
cards.back: No — it is a means to follow the Qurʾān in a reliable, systematic, methodical, and coherent manner

cards.front: What is the ruling on following a مَذْهَب?
cards.back: Not technically wājib or farḍ, but very highly encouraged

cards.front: In what sense does the average person not have a مَذْهَب?
cards.back: Their madhhab is that of the imam they go to with their questions

cards.front: Why should a student choose a مَذْهَب once they begin studying?
cards.back: To develop coherence and internal consistency

cards.front: Historically, what determined which مَذْهَب a person followed?
cards.back: Schools developed in particular regions; people followed the one they had access to
